item.title: 2 shot, 1 fatally, outside Bridgeview bar and pool hall, police say
item.description: Two people were shot, one fatally, outside of a south suburban bar and pool hall early Saturday morning, officials said.

item.title: All lanes of southbound DuSable Lake Shore Drive reopen after multi-vehicle crash on South Side
item.description: All lanes of southbound DuSable Lake Shore Drive were closed after a multi-vehicle crash Saturday night on the city's South Side, officials said. At least 10 vehicles were possibly involved in the crash.

item.title: At least 2 injured in large apartment fire in East Garfield Park, Chicago fire officials say
item.description: At least two people were injured as Chicago firefighters battled a large apartment fire Saturday on the city's West Side, CFD officials said.

item.title: Bodies of all 9 missing skiers in deadly California avalanche have been recovered, authorities say
item.description: Crews recovered the bodies of nine backcountry skiers who were killed in a California avalanche, authorities said Saturday.

item.title: Chicago family's dog stolen near daycare in Lincoln Park, owner says: 'We're on edge'
item.description: The last time the 5-year-old dog, Charlie, was seen by his owner was when she tied him up outside a nearby daycare to rush in to get her kids. She's hoping a trail of videos could help lead to the person who may have took him.

item.title: 17-year-old, 18-year-old charged in deadly carjacking spree across Chicago ordered held in custody
item.description: A 17-year-old and an 18-year-old are both being charged as adults in connection with a deadly carjacking spree that happened earlier this month, Chicago police said. They were ordered to remain in jail until trial.

item.title: Woman killed, 2 others seriously injured in wrong-way crash on I-65 near Merrillville, Indiana: ISP
item.description: A wrong-way crash left one woman dead and two others seriously injured in northwest Indiana early Saturday, police said.

item.title: Faith leaders honor Rev. Jesse Jackson at 1st Rainbow PUSH Coalition forum since his death
item.description: Faith leaders paid tribute to the late Rev. Jesse Jackson at the Rainbow PUSH Coalition's first Saturday morning forum since his passing.

item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry as a partial government shutdown continues.

item.title: Body found in Lake Michigan near Hyde Park, Chicago police say
item.description: Chicago police are investigating after a body was recovered from Lake Michigan Saturday evening on the city's South Side.
